[[File:Lene Buhl-Mortensen 2017 (cropped).jpg|thumb|Lene Buhl-Mortensen in 2017]]
'''Lene Buhl-Mortensen''' (born 20 June 1956 in [[Esbjerg]]) is a Dano-Norwegian [[marine biology|marine biologist]]. She is a [[Academic ranks in Norway#Research professor|Research Professor]] at the [[Norwegian Institute of Marine Research]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.imr.no/om_havforskningsinstituttet/ansatte/b/lene_buhl-mortensen/nb-no|title=Lene Buhl-Mortensen|work=Havforskningsinstituttet|access-date=2016-01-31|archive-date=2014-01-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140118065545/http://www.imr.no/om_havforskningsinstituttet/ansatte/b/lene_buhl-mortensen/nb-no|url-status=dead}}</ref> She is an expert on the [[biogeography]] of the [[amphipod]] fauna in Norwegian waters, on the [[taxonomy (biology)|taxonomy]] of amphipods, [[barnacle]]s and [[copepods]], and on mapping of [[biodiversity]] in the [[Barents Sea]].

She holds a fil.kand. degree in biology from the [[University of Gothenburg]] (1980) and a dr.scient. (PhD) from the [[University of Bergen]] (1994). She has been head of MAREANO, a national mapping program to document the [[topography]], [[Natural environment|environment]] and [[seabed]] fauna outside Norway funded directly over the [[state budget of Norway]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nrk.no/programmer/radio/p2-akademiet/1.6242504|title=Det skjulte landskap|author=|work=NRK|date=October 2008 }}</ref> She has also discovered several new species in this area.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aftenposten.no/nyheter/iriks/article3626315.ece|title=Forskere fant ni nye arter på den norske havbunnen|author=Ole Magnus Rapp|work=Aftenposten}}</ref>
